## 🎨 Design

- **KnightLoader follows GlimStone 4.8.0.** Every debrid service and hoster in the pickers and on the Accounts page shows its own mark from GlimStone's catalog. Services that left the catalog but still work in KnightLoader, such as LinkSnappy, Clicknupload and FileSpace, keep KnightLoader's own picture.
- **Every connected service on the Accounts page stands as a connection row:** debrid and hoster accounts, Usenet servers, seedboxes and captcha accounts. The status line carries plan and expiry, anything out of the ordinary is a badge right after the name, traffic left is a short bar, and every action is a button. The right-click menu of the old table is gone.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Setting a password asks for it twice.** A second field appears once you type, and Set password stays off until both match.
- **The app key is called the encryption key** in the app and the docs, which says what it does. It stays optional, and the variable `KL_APP_KEY` keeps its name.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A free Rapidgator download reads its link in more of the forms the page carries it.** Rapidgator took the captcha answer, but KnightLoader only knew two older ways the page holds the link and found none. It also asked for the captcha during the countdown only in theory: file pages show no captcha, so it now remembers the last one and asks for that early. A refused answer is asked again on the same page, up to three times, instead of starting a new countdown, and the log says what the page showed. Reported by @MueChris82 ([#308](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/308)).

## 🌐 Translations

- **All 42 languages use GlimStone's glossary,** so sign-in, account, instance, backup, session and the other shared words read the same in every app. Eleven Serbian texts that were still in Latin script are in Cyrillic.
